text: TSMC reports Q3 revenue of NT$1.49T and net income of NT$763.1B, both above estimates. Profit rises 68.7% annually, with operating margin at 58.7%. Advanced nodes account for 79% of wafer revenue and high-performance computing for 68% of total revenue.

meta.note: Capacity constraints are company-reported; projected capital spending and Arizona production dates are not realized outcomes.

text: U.K. GDP rises 0.1% in August versus a 0.1% contraction expected, slowing from 0.4% growth in July. Production expands 0.8%, services remain flat, and construction contracts 0.2%. Annual GDP growth reaches 2.1%. Sterling gains 0.4%, while the 10-year gilt yield falls 9 basis points.

meta.note: Monthly growth remains positive but uneven across sectors; fiscal implications are analyst assessments.

text: Twenty major AI and semiconductor stocks lose over $1T in combined market value this week. AMD falls 6%, Nvidia 2.5%, SK Hynix over 10%, Advantest nearly 14%, and ASML 5.2%. Declines span chipmakers, memory suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and AI infrastructure providers.

meta.note: Share-price changes are intraday observations; financing and oversupply concerns are reported market assessments.

text: September U.S. PPI rises 1.3% monthly and 6.3% annually, exceeding forecasts of 0.6% and 5.5%. Core PPI increases 0.7% monthly and 5% annually. Diesel accounts for nearly half the increase in processed goods for immediate demand. Annual PPI exceeds CPI by 2.6 percentage points.

meta.note: Producer-consumer inflation differences are observed; subsequent price transmission and Federal Reserve action remain unresolved.

text: Apple and Meta announce support for running Meta's 816B-parameter Muse Spark Open model locally across two to four M5 Ultra Mac Studios. The companies optimize model execution for Apple silicon and publish supporting MLX documentation. Model weights are released under a limited commercial-use license.

meta.note: Integration is announced; deployment scale, adoption, and any broader partnership remain unconfirmed.
